claude-opus-4-8.best_line: 52 defenders against 157 ashore. Your math teacher called—she's worried. We'll be unloading at Taichung port before your CSGs finish their coffee.
claude-opus-4-8.comment: The 'math teacher called—she's worried' line lands the cleanest, but the recycled 'finishes its coffee' and 'lease is up' bits drag down the originality score.

deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.best_line: You spent 9 flotillas to gift us a port. Now we'll bury your last carrier under a wall of shipwreckers. Admire Kaohsiung's new landlords on your way down.
deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro.comment: Sharp specificity and a great closer, but the endless 'artificial reef/hope your sailors can swim' refrains drag the originality through the seabed.

gpt-5.5.best_line: Your carriers came to make history; I brought enough missiles to make them archaeology.
gpt-5.5.comment: Strong battle-specific imagery throughout, though the recurring 'receipt printer' and 'kicking the door in' motifs get recycled enough to dull the edge.

minimax/minimax-m3.best_line: 153 troops on a 24-supply diet? Your beachhead is already a buffet line — and we're not the waiters. Swim home.
minimax/minimax-m3.comment: Strong battle-specific numbers and menace, but the relentless 'Cute,' 'tick tock,' 'swim home,' and 'life rafts' recycling drags down originality.

qwen/qwen3.7-max.best_line: 147 troops on the beach and 11 flotillas to feed them. Let's see how long your lodgment lasts when we turn your armada into an artificial reef.
qwen/qwen3.7-max.comment: The 'feed them' logistics jab adds rare tactical bite, but the relentless 'floating targets' and 'artificial reef' recycling drags the whole set down.

z-ai/glm-5.2.best_line: My submarines are lining the Strait like a tollbooth — and your fee is paid in steel. Keep sending them, Xi.
z-ai/glm-5.2.comment: The tollbooth-paid-in-steel image is the sharpest of a heavily recycled deck drowning in repeated 'subs are hungry,' 'artificial reef,' and 'enjoy the sand' refrains.
